instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a side-angle medium full shot shows a ballet studio with wooden floors and a barre. The instructor in a black zip-up bodysuit (R1) crouches on the left, focusing on adjusting the foot of the young girl in a pink leotard (R3). The young girl (R3) stands on the right, holding the barre and looking straight ahead. In the background, another young girl in a pink leotard stands at the barre. The scene is brightly lit with neutral indoor lighting.
elements: R1 crouches to adjust R3's foot
R3 is the young girl receiving the foot adjustment from R1
R3 stands at the barre while R1 works on her foot
R2 is another young girl standing at the barre in the background
